page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8s.4xlarge is a compute-optimized, GPU-accelerated virtual workstation instance provisioned via the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz, providing 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. System memory is sized at 32.0 GB RAM, yielding 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU slice (0.3333 of an A10) equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. Baseline network bandwidth is configured at 5 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included and no local storage provided.

Instruction set features for the Intel processor include AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside cryptographic extensions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. Cache topology offers 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Memory bandwidth benchmarks indicate uncached large-block reads at 77.1 GB/sec and writes at 51.61 GB/sec, with cached small-block reads reaching 1675.59 GB/sec. Compute benchmarks place performance within the middle 50% average range, achieving 1590.0 in Geekbench single-core, 12813.0 in Geekbench multi-core, and 29573.87 on the PassMark CPU test.

GPU-driven machine learning workloads show 1154.59 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 243.2 tokens/sec for text generation when running small 135M parameter language models. For medium 7B models, inference rates moderate to 32.25 tokens/sec for prompt ingestion and 12.06 tokens/sec for token generation. Due to the 8 GB VRAM capacity of the fractional GPU slice, large 70B parameter models cannot be loaded, highlighting a strict boundary on parameter density. Furthermore, the absence of local storage necessitates external network-attached volumes for all persistence requirements.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the fractional GPU allocation permits workloads requiring mild GPU acceleration to avoid the overhead of full-die GPU reservations. This profile balances mid-tier multi-threaded CPU throughput with GPU assist, making it technically suitable for cloud workstation streaming (VDI), lightweight model inference, Clang build jobs, and batch graphics or image processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8s.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance delivering fractional GPU acceleration on the KVM hypervisor. It features a 16-vCPU, 8-physical-core Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz with AVX-512 support, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM (2.0 GB per core). Graphics and tensor acceleration are driven by a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU allocation (0.3333 slice) offering 8 GB of VRAM. The instance operates with a 5 Gbps baseline network profile and contains no local storage, requiring network-attached storage. Benchmark testing establishes average middle-tier results, reaching a Geekbench multi-core score of 12813.0, PassMark CPU score of 29573.87, and 12.06 tokens/sec text generation on 7B parameter language models. This instance is suitable for virtual workstation streaming, software compilation, graphics processing, and small-to-medium deep learning inference pipelines.
